info.name: NovaBank API
info.description:
Every NovaBank endpoint through the API gateway. Works in Postman and Hoppscotch (Hoppscotch: Collections > Import > Postman collection).

Run '1. Auth > Login' requests first; they store the tokens. Pick the local, dev or preprod environment for baseUrl.

request.description: Stores the JWT in the collection variable `token`. Run this first.
Stores the JWT in `adminToken`, used by every request in the Admin folder.
Pre-request script makes a fresh Idempotency-Key. Use 'Replay same transfer' to prove it is not charged twice.
